title: Bank booking
description: One booking of a bank account the member views, redacted as on the member's account page: no holders and no staff note. Foreign bank data: a client keeps it in memory only, for at most 7 days.

postingId.description: Opaque identifier issued by the Basetool. Clients store and echo it, never parse it.

transactionId.description: Opaque identifier issued by the Basetool. Clients store and echo it, never parse it.

amount.description: The signed amount of this account's leg in whole aUEC.

justification.description: The justification of a withdrawal or transfer; null otherwise.

reversedTransactionId.description: The transaction a reversal corrects; null otherwise.

counterAccount.description: The other account of a transfer leg; null otherwise.

intraAccount.description: Whether both legs of the booking are on this account.

transferFee.description: The transfer fee borne by the debited account in whole aUEC; null without one.

counterpartyHandle.description: The handle of the member who handed the money in or received it; null when none was recorded or they withhold their name from connected applications.
